meta.track: kin_rates (Claude, own code), 26 October 2026; BRIEF_KINETIC.md item: collision kernels of the light sector
meta.model: U = lP/4 (phi^2-v^2)^2 + g^2 phi^2 |X|^2 + lX |X|^4, phi = v + s; tree amplitudes (Berends-Giele recursion, exact vertices of U)
meta.units: GeV; n = int d^3p f/(2pi)^3 per bosonic degree (X, Xb, s: one each); gamma = reactions per volume per time (GeV^4) with S_in and S_out included; <sigma v> = gamma S_in/(n1 n2) (GeV^-2); sigma (GeV^-2) includes 1/S_out; Gt(s) = int dPhi_n dPhi_2 |M|^2 (dimensionless), gamma_{n->2}(T) = (1/(S_in S_out)) (T/8pi^3) int ds sqrt(s) K1(sqrt(s)/T) Gt(s); gamma_{2->n}(T) = (1/S_in) (T/32pi^4) int ds lambda(s,m1^2,m2^2) sigma(s) K1(sqrt(s)/T)/sqrt(s)
meta.statistics: all thermal tables are Maxwell-Boltzmann at mu = 0 (tabulated per channel); Bose/MB correction factors at T/mX = 0.3, 1, 3, 7.344, 12 from the lab-frame MC with Bose f and 1+f (mc_checks); a momentum-grid solver should use sigma(s)/Gt(s) with its own f; a moments closure should multiply the MB table by the interpolated Bose factor and by exp(sum mu_in/T) for chemical potentials (exact for MB; Bose at mu != 0 needs the full integral)
meta.symmetry_factors: S_in = product of n! over identical incoming species, S_out likewise; included in gamma and sigma; the collision term for species i then carries the multiplicity of i in the channel
meta.resonances: RIS (narrow-width) subtraction: for every internal line that can be on shell in the physical region (s from a neutral X Xb pair, X from a charge +-1 subset) |D|^2 -> Re(D^2) with D = 1/(p^2 - m^2 + i m Gamma_reg), including nested and disjoint multi-line terms by inclusion-exclusion; the removed on-shell pieces are the sequential chains that the network carries explicitly (1<->2, 2<->2, 3<->2 with real s/X).  The 2->2 quadrature uses the physical width (XXb_XXb s-pole) and Gamma_X,reg = 1e-7 m_X (Xs_Xs u-pole); the MC uses Gamma_reg = 0.02 m_s and 0.05 m_X (primary) and 0.04/0.10 (secondary): the spread is the regulator systematic of the finite part; the regulated full column scales as 1/Gamma_reg where on-shell lines dominate
meta.in_medium: kernels at vacuum masses; masses(T) and the phase in masses_T; validity in masses_T.validity
meta.provenance: Codex packets read only via git show/archive (9877518 KINETIC_SPEC.md, MATHEMATICS.md; 225028b INPUTS.json); no Codex code run; own earlier tracks reused: Berends-Giele method of gp_leftovers/amp42.py (re-implemented), threshold constants [Q own] for comparison
